teachingReplacement.preservedQuestion: Choosing/customizing can itself be play; make effects, differences, finding and trial understandable before appearance/expression.
preservedOrder: Tradeoffs and fictional worked damage example

scene04.role: Reduce the effort needed to find and compare candidate equipment.
scene04.beginnerPrerequisite: A category groups similar item types; an icon is a small picture identifying that type. Explain the currently selected category before pointing at the grid.
scene04.observableBefore: Current category and its list visible together, with a readable category name/icon.
scene04.observableAction: Move to another actually recorded category, or select a clearly identified item.
scene04.observableResult: The list, item details or equipped character state changes in the way the visible action establishes.
scene04.connection: Return to the general icon explanation, ACNH face/hair category example, then our separate sorting list.
mustNotInfer: Unseen tabs such as armor are demonstrated merely because BOTW has them
A small raw inventory shot is legible evidence without mobile crop/callout review

scene06.role: Bring the visible outcome of choosing closer to the choice action; preserve the short trial-feedback lesson without requiring crafting.
scene06.beginnerPrerequisite: Explain which weapon is currently equipped and distinguish the selection highlight from actual equipped confirmation.
scene06.observableBefore: Current weapon or tool visible in the world or equipment indicator.
scene06.observableAction: Change to a different identified weapon through an actually recorded menu or quick bar.
scene06.observableResult: Return to the same nearby context and visibly wield/fire/hit using that weapon. Mark the hand/weapon/target only after verified frame inspection.
scene06.connection: The actual choice/use result leads to the general choice→trial→change diagram and then the question of appearance versus strength.
scene06.acceptableOutcome: An actual nearby swing, shot or hit is enough to illustrate trying the choice. Do not demand a measured damage comparison or force a wall-breaking action.
scene06.equivalenceLimit: This demonstrates weapon selection/use, not attaching parts, crafting, dedicated training facilities, instant undo or proof of a fully repeated closed loop.
mustNotInfer: A changed inventory cursor proves a successful equip
A cut to unrelated combat proves use of the selected weapon
A recorded normal battle is a controlled testing room
Observed enemy damage is a standardized DPS measurement

fictionalMathPreserved.label: Entirely fictional illustrative values, not BOTW/Raiders/ACNH game measurements.
